text:
maria.g: Heads-up: marketplace launch timeline needs a final sign-off. joint announce with EdgeCon + three SI partners. propose embargo Tue 2026-05-12 09:00 PT.
neal: timeline ok from product side if API contract locks by 2026-04-14. we need the schema and webhook examples.
tanya: content ask: landing page must surface partner integrations + one short 'how it works' flow. can provide draft copy by 2026-04-25.
edgecon-marketing: EdgeCon can supply partner logo, two lifestyle photos, and a short quote. target delivery 2026-04-21 if specs include safe zones and color guidelines.
ops-bot: FYI: Marketplace staging cutover for May publish is 2026-04-25 17:00 PT. add 48h buffer for VPC/customer onboards.
maria.g: Checklist draft below. please call out owners inline.
```
- 2026-04-10: Finalize SKU mapping and pricing exclusion (owner: neal)
- 2026-04-14: API contract + webhook schema freeze (owner: neal)
- 2026-04-18: Legal approves partner quote language (owner: legal)
- 2026-04-21: EdgeCon assets delivered (owner: edgecon-marketing)
- 2026-04-22: Co-brand lockup approved (owner: ux)
- 2026-04-25: Staging tenant provisioning cutoff (owner: ops-bot)
- 2026-04-26: Draft blog & PR shared for review (owner: pm-comm)
- 2026-04-28: Landing page copy freeze (owner: tanya)
- 2026-05-05: Localization + alt-text complete (owner: ux)
- 2026-05-12: Embargo lift & public announce 09:00 PT
```
neal: Addendum: for SKU mapping, we need a fallback plan if EdgeCon requests a custom SKU after launch. propose 'post-launch SKU patch' with a one-week grace.
maria.g: Good point. add fallback: publish with generic hardware SKU and backfill specific SKU within 7 days if needed.
edgecon-marketing: Can we get exact image size + filetype? prefer PNG for logos, JPG for photos. will confirm by EOD.
ux: co-brand lockup spec: provide vector EPS/SVG, min clear space 24px, alignment variants for mobile. will post spec doc: https://drive.example.com/edgecon-lockup-spec
legal: we'll review partner quote boilerplate by 2026-04-18; push any redlines to the thread. keep pricing out of PR.
pm-comm: quick note: embargo wording must include partner-approved quote snippets before we send to press. schedule dry-run on 2026-05-07 10:00 PT?
maria.g: yes please schedule. also need to confirm the list of press contacts and target outlets.
ops-bot: Canary rollout plan (post-launch): 10% dedicated capacity -> monitor 4h -> 50% -> monitor 24h -> full. rollback trigger: error rate >0.2% or latency > 2.5x baseline.
neal: integration guide link required on landing page. I'll create the /docs/integrations edgecon-sis page and share link by 2026-04-20.
tanya: For the landing page, CTA hierarchy: 1) Try in sandbox 2) Request SI integration 3) Contact sales. need short copy for each CTA by 04-28.
edgecon-marketing: confirming quote: "EdgeCon and Redwood deliver sub-second inference at the edge." we'll send exact attribution line to legal.
legal: got it. send quote as a plaintext line here so we can sign off.
ux: small accessibility reminder: hero contrast must meet AA, buttons 44px min hit area, images require descriptive alt text. can audit on 2026-05-06.
maria.g: final owners recap: @neal (product & API), @tanya (landing copy), @ux (co-brand + accessibility), @pm-comm (PR/blog), @legal (quotes), @edgecon-marketing (assets). I'll send a partner timeline email in 30m.
edgecon-marketing: thanks — we'll aim for 04-21 delivery and ping if anything slips.
pm-comm: scheduled dry-run invite sent for 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. please RSVP.
ops-bot: Reminder: if any tenant requests private on-prem provisioning, alert ops 72h before cutover.
maria.g: thanks all. we'll reconvene in two weeks or sooner if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
